Note T2 was corrected to a valid label ("continue") reflecting the persisting operating relationship; the substrate that stayed was governed by a three-year marketing lockout and joint-marketing obligation rather than any transferred-but-orphaned process.

gemini.rationale: The transaction involved the transfer of an 80% joint venture interest from Charter Hall Office REIT to Beacon, along with the sale of specific properties (T4) out of the structure. The Company retained its 20% interest and continued as the operator (T5/T6) for the remaining properties. There is no documented structural mismatch at closing where products transferred without their corresponding processes or where processes transferred without their corresponding organization.

openai.rationale: The existing joint venture sold two properties and related development rights to Beacon affiliates, while three properties remained in the newly documented joint venture (SEC accession 0001204560-12-000018, Exhibit 99.1). The slice states that MPG remained the in-house operator and that no operating processes or management organization were reassigned to the counterparty, documenting a product-versus-process gap at closing but no process-versus-organization separation (SEC accession 0001204560-12-000018, Exhibit 99.1 and signature block; 0001204560-11-000089, Item 1.01). The lockout and joint-marketing provisions did not constitute a transitional-services or operating arrangement allocating the operational processes associated with the sold assets.
